Verify the final engine and phone flows with data produced by original commit bd25f38. Preserve the original scope exclusions in PLAN.md. Do not use a passing test as a claim that all possible defects are absent.

1. Capture real original-app saved state and check migration, unfinished sessions and existing history.
2. Exercise Today, Train, a combined day, focus/list logging, finish, Progress, Library and Settings at 390×844.
3. Exercise encrypted backup/restore, set CSV/import, conditioning setup/timer/outside logging, goals and the weekly summary.
4. Simulate months of estimates, constrained kit progression, weekly volume and deterministic lighter-week choices.
5. Review every numbered item and K requirement; document done, partial and excluded work with evidence.
6. Fix confirmed regressions, run the entire suite, merge autonomously, then verify deployed assets and deployment checks.

Physical iPhone keyboard behavior and notifications while a phone is locked require device testing. Keep those limits explicit.
